title: Jeweller’s Window
caption: Gold, diamonds and pearls, turning under the lights
blurb: Three rings and a string of pearls on a polished black plinth under a jeweller’s soft boxes, at real size and built entirely in code. The gold mirrors the lights and the other pieces, each stone is a 57-facet brilliant cut whose light goes in, bounces off the back facets and comes out again, and it all stays right when you change the metal or the stone.

controls.does: brings the camera close; again to return
